newsitem.title: USA: Nat'l Surgery files 2.75 mln common shrs.
newsitem.headline: Nat'l Surgery files 2.75 mln common shrs.

text.p: National Surgery Centers Inc filed Friday with the Securities and Exchange Commission for up to 2.75 million common shares.
Of the total, the company said it will sell 2.0 million shares while certain shareholders will offer 746,989 shares.
It said net proceeds will be used to repay debt and for general corporate purposes, including future acquisitions and development.
The offering will be made through an underwriting group led by Alex. Brown & Sons Inc. The underwriters have an over-allotment option for up to 746,989 additional shares.
